title: fix(motion): start the depth ladder one stepdown under Top Z
body:
**Round 10 done (head `f58fda19364fe35b62733298550b4ee216eb35a0`). The floor review finding is fixed and pinned. The branch has `main` merged in. The PR stays a draft.**

## Round 10 (head `f58fda19364fe35b62733298550b4ee216eb35a0`)

Merged `origin/main` (79 commits). One conflict: `examples/first-router-part.camproj` (main moved the stamp salt to `camcraft-op-stamp-v3`). The file is regenerated with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` from the test's command build; against the old branch head only the file version and the 3 stamps changed.

Fix of the floor review (comment of head `68b5315c8`):
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/rest/mod.rs` (from `main`): Rest Adaptive called `cut_levels`, which drops the level at Top Z. The rest stock stands over the rest Top Z, so the first rest level (Z -2.0) was lost, and Z -2.0..-4.0 had no cut and no refusal. Now: `cut_levels_under(top_z, material_top.or(Some(f64::INFINITY)), ...)`. With no material top stated, the rest ladder keeps the level at Top Z. A stated material top at or under Top Z still drops it.
- Pin: `machining2d::adaptive::rest::tests::the_first_rest_level_at_top_z_is_cut_without_a_stated_material_top`. It fails without the fix ("the first rest level (Z-2) has no cut") and passes with it. The 4 `rest_adaptive` tests of the review pass.

Goldens that `main` added and that this PR moves (each one is class (a): the stock top is Top Z, and the removed level cut only air):
- `crates/app/tests/golden/pocket_rest_corners.cl`: 126 to 85 moves. The Z 20 level is gone; Z 18 and Z 16 keep the same paths.
- `examples/first-4axis-part.nc` and `.camproj`: the pass at the bar skin (Z0.375) is gone from each flat and from the cross slot. The cross slot keeps Z0.365, Z0.355, Z0.345. `first_4axis_part::each_flat_posts_the_same_cut_after_its_index` now asserts one plunge and one pass at Z0.36. The guide page `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-4axis-part.md` quotes the new program.
- No snapshot PNG changed. No verify, collision or gouge check changed.

Readings (debug), round 10:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion` on the merge commit `2f5e39d72`: 91 binaries, 1077 passed, 0 failed, 53 ignored.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on `2f5e39d72`: post suites 67 binaries 608 passed; motion suites 58 binaries 869 passed; `blind_floor` 1, `rotary_offset` 2 passed; app suites 475 binaries, 3429 passed, 4 failed (`first_4axis_part` 3, `rest_pocket` 1; the goldens above). The gate marked the run VOID because I regenerated these files during the app step.
- On the final head: `first_4axis_part` 4/4, `rest_pocket` 6/6, `first_router_part` 4/4 passed; `site/tests/test_first_4axis_part.py` 12/12 (in UTF-8 mode). The final head changes no source file after `2f5e39d72`, only tests, goldens, examples and docs.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` on the final head: clean.

Not exercised: a full quick gate run again on the final head, the heavy and `--ignored` lanes, the pixel snapshots, and a run on a real control.

Changelog: Depth-stepping operations no longer cut a first level at Top Z when no stock stands over Top Z; posted programs have one level fewer.

Effort: high (no escalation).


## Round 6 (head `185a69f1e06bd7737a3c35c2ed1ae74c6716c112`)

Merged `origin/main` (29 commits, no conflict). `emit_level` moved to `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trochoid_level.rs` (plain move, 400-line law). The CRLF files of earlier rounds are LF again.

Goldens regenerated with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1` and read. In each file the only change is the loss of the level at Top Z (it cut air) and its links. No gouge, verify, load, collision or solid check is loosened.

| Golden | Moves or lines | Read diff |
|---|---|---|
| `golden_cl` 11 files (slot, trace, contour, pocket, face stepped) | for example `contour_disc_hole` 69 to 46, `face_square_40x40_stepped` 48 to 36 | one contiguous deletion of the Z 0 level (Z 2 for the stepped face) |
| `circular_ring_arcs.cl` | 417 to 401 | the -0.508 level is gone. The same circles. The helix ramp descends from the plunge height in one run: 2.73 deg, under `DEFAULT_RAMP_ANGLE` 3.0 |
| 96 posted `.nc` (fanuc, carvera, doosan-dnm, grblhal, haas, heidenhain, mazak, sinumerik, tinyg, tormach, inch) | - | one deletion hunk each, after the N numbers are removed. The removed Z words are only the Top Z level |
| `adaptive2d_trochoidal_*.cl` (4) | for example 6096 to 3048 | the z 20 level is gone. The z 17 level is the same |
| `contour_bore_arc_entry.cl` | 27 to 18 | the Z 0 level is gone. The first entry arc is on the same radius 6 circle and starts at the plunge height Z 2 |
| `contour_start_point.cl` | 43 to 29 | the Z 0 level is gone |
| `contour_control_comp.nc`, `contour_wear_comp.nc` (fanuc, haas, mazak, sinumerik) | 11 to 16 lines fewer | the Z 5 level is gone. The wear comment moves to the first comp pass |
| `fanuc-lathe/facing.nc`, `facing_css.nc`, `inch/fanuc-lathe/facing.nc` | 5 lines fewer | the rung at the work top (Z 16) is gone. The first pass is Z 15.5 |
| `thread_mill_external_m8_multi_form.nc` | 6 lines fewer | the Z 20 roughing ring is gone |
| `docs/tester-kits/tormach-microarc-4th/microarc_test_part.nc` | 15 lines fewer | the Z 0.375 pass is gone. The `.camproj` re-save is not kept (only a format change) |
| post inputs `vertical_arc_{x,y,oblique}.cl` (round 5) | 33 to 22, 54 to 40 | the Z 0 level is gone |

Fixtures:
- `golden_cl::face_square_40x40_stepped`: plunges 4 to 3 (levels 0.5, -1.0, -2.0).
- `solid_law_goldens::a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused`: the crossings of the lost level go (Arc 4, Tangential 8). Each one still refuses.
- `thread_boss::a_part_wall_the_roughing_left_standing_in_the_sweep_is_refused`: the rib top is 12 (it was 16). With levels `[15, 10]`, a rib top over 15 makes the roughing refuse its first level by name ("every contour ring cuts into the part at its first level"). The old roughing walked only the air level 20. At 12 the roughing walks 15, stops above the rib, and the thread air law still refuses "stands at z 12.000".

Readings (debug), round 6, each green:
- app: `golden_cl` 33, `conformance` 7, `solid_law_goldens` 7, `program_units` 7, `arc_entry` 3, `contour_start_point` 8, `control_comp` 5, `wear_comp` 5, `lathe_post` 7, `lathe_post_css` 10, `lathe_post_inch` 6, `adaptive_trochoid` 12, `microarc_test_part` 2, `thread_boss` 12, `engrave_law` 9, `mill2d_b` 9, `verify` 21, `trochoid_confine` 6, `trochoid_law` 7, `trochoid_op` 5, `top_z_stock_over` 2, `tinyg_post` 18, `tormach_post` 10, `tormach_end_units` 7, `program_comments` 4, `post_cycle_feed_spindle` 8, `plasma_post_refusals` 7, and the lathe, wire, sinker, c-axis and probe post suites; lib `ladder_planes`.
- motion: `top_z_level` 13, `machining2d` 66, `vertical_arc_entry` 3, `trochoid_slot` 11. post: `vertical_arc_entry` 3, `arc_planes` 7, `fanuc_post` 12.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not exercised: the full quick gate (all app suites), the heavy and `--ignored` lanes, a run on a real control, and operations that have no golden.

Changelog: Depth-stepping operations no longer cut a first level at Top Z when no stock stands over Top Z; posted programs have one level fewer.

Effort: high (no escalation).


## What changed

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/levels.rs`: the shared level law `cut_levels` starts at `top - stepdown` and ends at `bottom` exactly. `top 20, bottom 0, step 5` gives `[15, 10, 5, 0]`. Each level below the first is the same float as before. `cut_levels` is now `pub`.
- Round 3: `cut_levels_under(top, material_top, bottom, stepdown)`. When the material top stands over Top Z, the level at Top Z stays (the old ladder, byte for byte). `None`, or a material top at or under Top Z, gives the new ladder.
- Round 3: `camcraft_motion::approach::Approach` gets the runtime field `material_top: Option<f64>` (default `None`, not in the project file). The callers that carry `links` use `cut_levels_under`: pocket, HSM pocket, trochoidal pocket, adaptive trochoidal, slot, contour, bore, circular (not vault), 3D entry ladder.
- Round 3: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` sets `material_top` from `stock_top_z` (in the generator frame). `crates/app/src/operation/area.rs`: `ladder_planes` reads the same material top (part top or setup stock top), so the region planes are the generator levels.
- Round 3: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_bore.rs`, `contour_step.rs`, `contour.rs`: a bore-side level transition whose column no earlier descent opened starts at the top of the cut plus the plunge height. It does not start at the floor of the level before.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/circular.rs`: vault mode. A plane at Top Z is dropped. An inner ring keeps the floor of the ring before it as its first level.
- `crates/motion/src/turning/face.rs`: a rung exactly at the top of the work is dropped.
- Decisions: `docs/decisions/2004-top-z-level.md` (items 3 and 4d are now decided).

Posted G-code changes: each depth-stepping operation that uses the level law cuts one level fewer (the air level at Top Z), unless stock stands over Top Z. Then the program keeps the old levels. The bore-side helix transition of the first level now starts 2 mm (plunge height) over the top of the cut. This is under the safety floor.


## Round 5 (head `b18b928131467a963022f3efcd6bc6352fd07599`)

Code:
- `TraceParams` and `TrochoidParams` get `material_top: Option<f64>`. `trace` and the trochoidal slot `finish` use `cut_levels_under`. `generate.rs` fills the field for Trace, Engrave and Trochoidal slot from `lk.approach.material_top` (the stock top). `trochoid_op::trochoid_params` takes it as a parameter. The lanes of 2D Adaptive (Trochoidal) copy it from the pocket links. Decision item 9.
- With Top Z under the stock top, no first cut of these operations is deeper than one stepdown.

Recorded files changed (the only change is the loss of the air level at Top Z):
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/inputs/vertical_arc_x.cl`: 33 to 22 moves. The Z 0 level is gone. The Z -2 entry arc is the same circle (centre X17 Z6), entered from the plunge height Z 2 over Top Z.
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/inputs/vertical_arc_y.cl`: 33 to 22 moves. The same change in G19 (centre Y7 Z6).
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/inputs/vertical_arc_oblique.cl`: 54 to 40 moves. The Z 0 level is gone. The chord descent of the first level starts at Z 2 over Top Z.
- Posted output change (post `vertical_arc_entry`): one G18 or G19 arc block fewer, two instead of three (levels Z -2 and Z -4). The test now counts 2. The plane words and the Heidenhain law are not changed.

Tests (debug), round 5:
- New: `top_z_level::a_trace_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z`, `top_z_level::a_trochoidal_slot_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z` (motion); `top_z_stock_over::a_trace_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z`, `top_z_stock_over::a_trochoidal_slot_under_stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z` (app, levels `[18, 15, 12]` on a stock top of 20).
- Green: motion `top_z_level` 13, `trochoid_slot` 11, `machining2d` 66, `vertical_arc_entry` 3 (after `WRITE_GOLDEN=1`); post `vertical_arc_entry` 3.
- Green: app lib `ladder_planes_match_the_level_law_and_never_hang` (filter run, 4 tests); filtered runs of `engrave_law` 2, `mill2d_b` 3, `trochoid_confine` 1, `trochoid_law` 6, `trochoid_op` 3, `verify` 1, `top_z_stock_over` 2.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Goldens, run without regeneration (red, not changed):
- `golden_cl` 12 of 33 red: `face_square_40x40_stepped` (levels 4 to 3), `contour_plate_with_hole`, `contour_plate_with_hole_blended`, `contour_disc_hole`, `contour_tangential_lead`, `pocket_waterline`, `pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island`, `pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island_blended`, `slot_fullwidth_centerline`, `slot_wide_channel_rows`, `trace_plate_with_hole`, `circular_ring_arcs`. Each read diff loses the level at Top Z 0 (stale golden file).
- `solid_law_goldens` 4 of 7 red: `every_depth_law_golden_verifies_exactly_as_before` and `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` (stale golden: `contour_disc_hole.cl` 69 to 46 moves, the Z 0 level is gone); `the_slot_trace_and_plasma_goldens_pass_their_gates` (`slot_fullwidth_centerline.cl` 14 to 9 moves, the Z 0 level is gone); `a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused` (the crossing list loses the two crossings of the third level, 6 to 4; the refusal stays).

## Round 4 (head `44ebc51dd1e6d5807af4f49237c66f49ce284f6e`)

Rotary verdict: the new refusal in `rotary_offset::the_height_window_names_the_stations_and_refuses_an_empty_one` is correct. With no stock, the wrap top is the skin maximum (rho 2.5). In the window v 0 to 8 the bar has rho 2.0 or less. The old levels were `[2.5, 1.5, 0.5]`, and only the level 2.5 had open area, with the tip on the stock skin. That program cut only air. The window v 19 to 28 is the same case. The test now pins the two windows as refusals by name ("nothing to cut"). The station asserts use windows with material: v 0 to 12 (cuts at z 12 or less) and v 10 to 28 (cuts at z 10 or more, more than 20 cuts). Decision item 8.

Code defects found in round 4: none. No gouge, verify, load or solid check is loosened.

Fixtures changed in round 4 (each old expectation counted the Top Z air level):
- `rotary_adaptive::a_window_too_narrow_for_the_helix_is_refused_by_name_before_planning`: the r7 skin level 7.0 was air. The refusal tag is now `ring_tag(5.0)`. An added assert: the r7 skin has no level.
- `rotary_adaptive::offset_rings_on_the_wrap_are_the_program_they_always_were`: the bar max is r6.0 in an r6.2 stock, so the 6.2 level was air. `GOLDEN_RINGS` is pinned again from (5263, 11592310142122113043) to (2363, 10359925331182573356). An added assert: no cut stands on rho 6.2.
- `adaptive_hsm` judge: descents 2 to 1 (top 0, bottom -5, step 5).
- `entry_arc::the_bore_contour_enters_each_level_on_a_tangent_arc` 3 to 2 fans; `the_wall_side_enters_on_a_tangent_arc_in_the_air_beside_the_wall` 3 to 2.
- `face_blend::conventional_and_staged_blend_every_level`: 12 to 8 arcs (levels -0.5, -2.0).
- `face_holes::staged_facing_lifts_over_the_hole_at_every_level`: plunges 3x to 2x. An added assert: no feed at z 0.
- `machining2d`: face steps `[4,3,2]` to `[3,2]`; face level snap `[4.5,3,2]` to `[3,2]` and `[4.5,2.5,2]` to `[2.5,2]`; contour level snap 4 to 3 plunges; tabs 6 to 5; `levels_3_zs()` is now `[-3, -6]`; zigzag fills 3 to 2, hops 12 to 8; waterline island bottom -3 to -6 (keeps two levels); zigzag clearance lifts 3 to 2; slot fill 3 to 2; trace loops 6 to 4; ramp, entry family and roughing rings start at -3.
- `circular_arcs`: 52 to 48 arcs (12 levels), ramps 26 to 24 or more.
- `arcs`: plain arcs 8 to 4, led 12 to 6, halves 2 to 1, closing 2 to 1.
- `corner_blend`: l_boss 3 to 2; bore 9 to 6 (notes "6 of 8 walked corner(s) rounded", "2 of 8 ... kept sharp"); plate hole 9 to 6; three z loops `[0,-2,-4]` to `[-2,-4]`.
- `corner_blend_arc_contour`: fillets 3 to 2 (note "2 of 4 walked corner(s) rounded").
- `vertical_arc_entry`: entry arc ends `[0, -2, -4]` to `[-2, -4]`.

Readings, round 4 (debug):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-fail-fast` on `3f9fe15ec`: each binary green except `vertical_arc_entry` (3 red).
- Re-run on the new head: `vertical_arc_entry` 3 red, each only at `guard_recording`. The entry asserts and the verify (silent) pass. The recordings `crates/post/tests/recorded/inputs/vertical_arc_{x,y,oblique}.cl` are stale. They are post-suite inputs and are not regenerated here (`WRITE_GOLDEN=1`, then post's `vertical_arc_entry`).
- Named runs: `rotary_offset` 9/9, `rotary_adaptive` 3 (3 ignored), `adaptive_hsm` 1 (5 ignored), `entry_arc` 12, `face_holes` 7, `face_blend` 8, `machining2d` 66, `circular_arcs` 5, `corner_blend` 14, `corner_blend_arc_contour` 1, `arcs` 8.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not done in round 4: trace and trochoidal slot do not read the material top (an app build is necessary; none is cached in the worktree).

## Round 3 findings

1. `one_descent`, case "bore lead none Ramp helix transition": a real rapid into stock. Hole radius 10, tool diameter 6, top 0, stepdown 2, levels `[-2, -4, -6]`. The ring at Z -2 sweeps only the band r 4 to 10. The core r < 4 stays at Z 0. Move 1539 rapided from Z 25 down to Z -2 at r 6.55. The tool disc (r 3.55 to 9.55) went 0.45 mm into the uncut core over Z -2 to 0. Now the rapid stops at Z 2.000 and the helix descends from there. Verify is not loosened.
2. Top Z below the stock top: fixed with `material_top` (above). The stock top is the raw setup stock. An earlier facing operation is not read, so that case keeps the old answer (one air level). That is the safe side.

## Readings (debug)

Green:
- `one_descent` 3/3, `top_z_level` 11/11 (new pin `stock_over_top_z_keeps_the_level_at_top_z`).
- `center_cut_law` 6/6, `predrilled_entry` 6/6, `level_links` 12/12 (fixtures: see below).
- `blind_floor` 2/2, `machining3d` 23/23, `overhang_2d` 3/3 (re-run after round 3).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo check -p camcraft-app --tests`: clean.
- Round 2 green list (not re-run): `circular_ramp_angle`, `solid_law`, `rotary_links`, `refusal_ghost`, `radial_step`, `rotary_dflat`, `rotary`, `turning_contour_stock`, `rest2d`, `refusal_ghost_frames`, `turning_prof`, `turning_contour`, `trochoid_slot`, `turning_blade`, `stock_seam`, `tiny_step`, `scallop_ceiling`, `swarf_reentry`, `ruling`, `turning_stock`, `swarf_pose_continuity`, `turning_coarse`, `turning_face`, `turning_bore`, `chamfer_circular`, `turning_form`, motion lib `circular` filter.

Fixtures changed in round 3 (each old expectation counted the Top Z air level; no assertion is loosened):
- `center_cut_law::the_engagement_limit_slows_the_first_diameter_of_each_level_then_lets_go`: levels `[0, -2, -4, -6]` to `[-2, -4, -6]`.
- `predrilled_entry::a_proved_hole_is_plunged_at_every_level_with_no_helix`: plunges `[0, -4, -8]` to `[-4, -8]`.
- `predrilled_entry::a_shallow_hole_serves_only_the_levels_it_reaches`: plunges `[0, -4]` to `[-4]`.
- `level_links`: `a_ramp_transition_descends_at_no_more_than_the_angle` 2 to 1 transitions; `keep_down_between_levels_never_rises_above_the_level_just_cut` 3 to 2; `contour_keep_down_descends_on_the_ring_by_every_arm` 3 to 2; `contour_ring_to_ring_keep_down_is_proved_or_named` gaps 4 to 3 (two places); `the_helix_entry_is_one_continuous_descent` 3 to 2 helixes.
- `rotary_offset::the_seam_closes_into_a_full_ring`: the probe ring moves from the wrap top (rho 2.5, the material top, no level now) to the first level (rho 1.5).

Red in round 3 (all fixed in round 4, see above):
- `rotary_offset` 1: `the_height_window_names_the_stations_and_refuses_an_empty_one`. The window v 0 to 8 now refuses with `Empty("nothing to cut: ... at every level")`. The bar in that window has radius 2.0 or less, and the wrap top is rho 2.5. The old program appears to cut only air at rho 2.5. A reader must decide: a new window for the fixture, or a defect. Not changed.
- `face_blend` 1, `face_holes` 1, `entry_arc` 2, `adaptive_hsm` 1, `rotary_adaptive` 2, `machining2d` 14, `circular_arcs` 2, `corner_blend_arc_contour` 1, `corner_blend` 3, `arcs` 2. Not read in round 3.

## Not exercised

- The full app suites (only the named filters ran). `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens` are red and not regenerated.
- A bore helix that changes its radius between levels (the opened-column law assumes the same placement).
- Callers without `links` keep `cut_levels` and do not read the material top: face (own law), vault.

## Audit (per operation)

- Via the level law (changed): 2D Pocket and rest 2D, 2D Adaptive and Trochoidal, Contour (all sides), Slot, Trace, Trochoidal slot, Bore, Circular, staged Face, 3D Pocket and its rest pass, rotary wrap rough.
- Own loop, changed: turning face (exact multiple of the stepdown).
- Own loop, not affected: Finish 3D rings, turning groove and parting, thread infeed, thread-mill passes, turning profile and contour rough, drilling peck, chamfer, sinker, wire EDM, plasma, 5-axis.

Follow-up: #2012 (last step remainder against equal steps).

Changelog: Depth-stepping operations no longer cut a first level at Top Z when no stock stands over Top Z; the first level is one stepdown under Top Z.

Effort: high
